summary: Iteration 2: Verified referee PIN flow + numeric input string-coercion bug fixes + new IPN guinda + yellow brand. Backend: 40/40 tests passing (existing 20 regression + new 20 covering string coercion, PIN auto-generation, owner-only PIN GET/rotate, /api/referee/auth, /api/referee/{slug}/matches, /api/referee/matches/{mid}/result with persistence, /api/referee/matches/{mid}/sheet GET/PUT, plus 401/404 negative paths). Frontend Playwright: register->dashboard->create works; numeric inputs (canchas, duracion_bloque) accept clear+retype (verified '15' typed correctly, then changed to '2'); TournamentDetail PIN button uses bg-ipnYellow; PIN reveal toggle, copy & rotate buttons work and rotate persists (api re-auth with old pin returns 401); /arbitro RefereeLogin shows toast + stays on page on wrong PIN, navigates to /arbitro/{slug} on correct PIN; RefereeBoard renders 6 match rows, search filter trims to 2 with '09:00', cancha/status filter dropdowns visible; clicking a match opens RefereeScoreDialog with 'Modo simulador (BETA)' toggle and Set 1..5 inputs; saving sets via referee endpoint returns 2-0 score and persists; PublicView renders TABLAS DE POSICIONES before ROL DE PARTIDOS for both quick & league; league public groups by jornada fecha (2026-04-01 visible).

issues: Eye/EyeOff toggle button has no data-testid (uses title='Mostrar'); minor testability gap, not user-facing

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid='toggle-pin-visibility' to the Eye/EyeOff button in TournamentDetail RefereePinCard for cleaner testability.
critical_code_review_comments: RefereePinUpdate Pydantic model is defined and there's a PUT /api/tournaments/{tid}/referee-pin route that lets the owner SET an arbitrary PIN (4-8 chars, validated by Field). Not exercised by frontend yet; works fine in API tests. Consider also enforcing digits-only via Pydantic regex if desired.
All referee endpoints correctly strip 'user_id' and 'referee_pin' from tournament responses—no PIN leak.
PUT /api/referee/matches/{mid}/sheet stores doc with upsert and excludes pin from doc; updated_at is set; good.
POST /api/referee/matches/{mid}/result uses pin auth without exposing tournament details—good.
Pydantic auto-coercion of '2' -> 2 works for canchas and duracion_bloque (int fields); the bug fix relies on Pydantic v2 default int parsing of numeric strings. Verified with explicit test.
server.py has grown to ~980 lines; consider splitting auth/, tournaments/, matches/, public/, referee/ routers for maintainability.
GET pin returns 404 to non-owners (because _get_tournament_or_404 raises 404 for any user_id mismatch). 404 vs 403 is acceptable here—obfuscates ownership.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical referee + design + numeric-input flows verified)

test_credentials: All test users created at runtime via /api/auth/register with TEST_ prefix. Demo seeded creds (demo@volleypro.com / Demo123!) and admin (admin@volleypro.com / Admin123!) exist per /app/memory/test_credentials.md but were NOT used by tests.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed tournaments and one match sheet at runtime. Some test data remains in DB for debugging (acceptable).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression entry points: (1) /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (20 baseline tests, ~5s) (2) /app/backend/tests/test_referee_and_bugs.py (20 iteration-2 tests, ~5s). Run both with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. Referee endpoints DO NOT need user JWT—they auth via PIN per request; PIN obtained from GET /api/tournaments/{tid}/referee-pin (owner only) or rotated via POST. RefereeLogin stores {slug, pin} in sessionStorage['vp_ref']; RefereeBoard reads it and re-auths via /api/referee/auth on mount. Match sheet collection: db.match_sheets, keyed by match_id, upserted on PUT. Frontend routes: /arbitro (login), /arbitro/:slug (board). VolleySimulator tested only at navigation level (BETA toggle visible, dialog opens); deep simulator phase progression (setup->toss->playing with rotation) not exercised by playwright—covered structurally by sheet PUT/GET tests on backend. PublicView ordering: standings first, then matches, grouped by jornada fecha (league) or by category (quick); unified search filters both sections.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration. The previously reported numeric-input clear+retype bug is verified fixed: frontend uses string state in CreateQuick.jsx/CreateLeague.jsx and Pydantic v2 auto-coerces string ints to int. Verified end-to-end.
